source: the model header (Trace conformance) and its SigmaObs/H definitions
hidden: H = diff(Events, SigmaObs): critical sections and RTOS calls a trace does not record (registration, token count reads, timeout-0 acquires, releases, snapshots, signals, flag clears), stale flags, error, err5, idle, drained, isr_full
projection: one buffered channel: its BufferedPut/PutFromISR/OverwroteOldest/DroppedNew/BufferedGet, the WaitBufferedFull/WaitBufferedEmpty naming it with their Resume, and the WaitAlt/Resume/AltSelected of single-guard Alternatives on it
identities: write index n: every BufferedPut, PutFromISR, OverwroteOldest and DroppedNew of the channel in record order, from 0; a BufferedGet carries the index of the write that last wrote the slot it read (the decoder's slot replay); events use index mod K, K = capacity + 2 of the model configuration
policy: from the buffered events' policy field (count << 16 | policy << 14 | capacity)

roles.blocking writer: BufferedPut after WaitBufferedFull + Resume of the same thread
roles.ALT writer: BufferedPut in a select() window of a thread whose Alternative has an output guard on the channel
roles.offer: BufferedPut of a task outside both (KeepNewest/KeepOldest output())
roles.blocking reader: BufferedGet after WaitBufferedEmpty + Resume of the same thread
roles.ALT reader: BufferedGet in a select() window of a thread whose Alternative has an input guard on the channel; the Alternative objects of one thread on the channel are one ALT end (used one after the other)

configurations.name: Part 1c SYS_C
requires: one write, by a task
one ALT reader: an Alternative with this one input guard, one select(), selecting it
no other reader
no OverwroteOldest/DroppedNew
capacity >= 1 (the model's capacity 2 never binds with one write)

configurations.name: Part 1c SYS_C2
requires: two writes, by one task
one ALT reader as for SYS_C and one blocking reader with one get
no OverwroteOldest/DroppedNew
capacity >= 1 (a smaller capacity only delays the writer, whose events are hidden)

configurations.name: Part 3 SYS_BUF
requires: Block, capacity 1
every write a blocking put; at most two writer threads with at most two writes each
every get a blocking get, by one thread
no ISR writes; ALT guards on the channel that transfer nothing are outside the model's alphabet

configurations.name: Part 5 SYS5R
requires: Block, capacity 2
readers: one ALT reader, an Alternative with this one input guard (any number of selects)
writers: ISRs only
at most one stale wakeup (STALE5)

configurations.name: Part 5 SYS5W
requires: Block, capacity 2
writers: one ALT writer with this one output guard
readers: one blocking reader
at most one stale wakeup

configurations.name: Part 5 SYS5RW
requires: Block, capacity 2
one ALT reader and one ALT writer, each an Alternative with this one guard
at most one stale wakeup

configurations.name: Part 2N SYS_KNE
requires: KeepNewest, capacity c <= 4 (the largest capacity whose ranges are checked; larger: not matched)
any task and ISR writes (-1: writing forever), any readers

configurations.name: Part 2bN SYS_KOE
requires: KeepOldest, capacity c <= 4 (the largest capacity whose ranges are checked; larger: not matched)
any task and ISR writes, any readers

configurations.name: Part 3N SYS_BUFN
requires: Block, capacity c <= 4 (the largest capacity whose ranges are checked; larger: not matched)
nw blocking writer threads (writing forever), one blocking reader thread

configurations.name: Part 5G SYS5G
configurations.system: SYS5G(c, ra, wa, wb, rb, wi, false)
requires: Block, capacity c <= 4 (the largest capacity whose ranges are checked; larger: not matched)
ra/wa: an ALT reader/writer end (one-guard Alternatives of one thread)
wb/rb: up to 2 blocking writer/reader threads
wi: interrupt writes
at least one ALT end or interrupt writes (else Part 3N)

events.trace: AltSelected of the ALT reader (with its BufferedGet)
Resume after WaitAlt of the ALT reader / writer
Resume after WaitBufferedFull of a blocking writer

stable_failures.applies: only when every thread using the channel (its blocking ends and ALT ends) waits on it at the stable point
stable_failures.awaited_environment: isr_put.*, if the channel is interrupt-fed and a read waits on it

gaps: identities exist only after the decoder's slot replay (checked by its ring-slot check)
token counts are not recorded: readiness (C) cannot be checked
isr_full (putFromISR returning false on a full Block channel) records nothing
the fixed parts have capacity 1 or 2; the parameterised parts are matched up to capacity 4, the largest whose range assertions are checked
Parts 2 (SYS_KN_NEW, starts full) and 2b (SYS_KO) are not used for conformance: Parts 2N and 2bN cover KeepNewest and KeepOldest from empty
